edges.description: Dominus's character-creation speech: 'You have betrayed the Grand Arena. Now Wraeclast shall be your audience.. and your foe.' The Duelist's legacy text says he killed a high-born lord in a duel ('That lord sang a different tune with six inches of steel in his guts') and was then called a criminal.

sources.locator: section 'Character creation' (Dominus speech) / 'Legacy intro'

edges.description: Dominus's character-creation speech: 'Swift and silent you stole the bounty of others.' The Ranger's legacy text says Oriath called her a 'poacher' and 'thief' and hauled her 'like cargo into exile' (the stated grievance is poaching).

sources.locator: section 'Character creation' (Dominus speech) / 'Legacy intro'

edges.description: Dominus's character-creation speech: 'Yours is a predatory profession. The business of butchery.' The Shadow's legacy text describes a contract killing ('Silence a big mouth'); the employers toasted the job and the Shadow was shipped into exile.

sources.locator: section 'Character creation' (Dominus speech) / 'Legacy Intro'

edges.description: Dominus's character-creation speech: 'When a Daughter strays away from the Light, she makes herself an Orphan.' The Witch's legacy text: 'Had they not taken my home with fire, I would not have taken their children.' The stated act is taking children; no formal charge is named.

sources.locator: section 'Character creation' (Dominus speech) / 'Legacy intro'

edges.description: Dominus's character-creation speech: 'You were once the chosen of God. A Templar. You are now the chosen of Wraeclast. An exile.' The Templar's legacy text: 'They exile me to the land of the damned.' The crime is only hinted at ('only to smite it asunder with one sinful blow'); no specific act is named.

sources.locator: section 'Character creation' (Dominus speech) / 'Legacy intro'

edges.description: Dominus's character-creation speech: 'But you only gave us Murder and Darkness... Now you will earn your redemption in Wraeclast.' The wiki's own prose (not an in-game quote) says the Scion was exiled for killing her husband on their wedding night.
